title: Montmorillonite loaded with nano calcium peroxide as an effective material to mitigate methane emission in shallow lakes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00221D, Paper
Shiming Fan, Tong Li, Xuexin Han, Yu Gu, Biao Li, Qinglong L. Wu
A novel material was developed for improving the water quality in shallow eutrophic lakes, reducing the greenhouse gas emissions and strengthening the capacity of lake ecosystems to respond to climate change.
